_comment: Supertrend bot — PAPER futures (DU672616): MNQ, MES, MGC on 5-min bars, RTH-only (09:30-16:00 ET), long_short. MES + MGC = plain Supertrend (no DEMA, no regime). MNQ = Supertrend + DEMA(200) trend filter (no regime). All keep partial_tp (trim half at 2R, runner trails 1R) to match the backtested strategies. Everything here is config-driven; rebuild with supertrend.ps1 after CODE changes only (JSON is read at startup).
_indicator_toggles: dema_filter.enabled and regime_filter.enabled are independent per-strategy switches (both default false). Plain Supertrend = both false. Supertrend+DEMA = dema_filter.enabled true, regime_filter.enabled false. To also gate by regime, set regime_filter.enabled true.
_partial_tp_comment: partial_tp trims each tranche at r_multiple*R (R=entry->initial stop) and, after the first trim >= tighten_after_r, trails the runner at trail_r*R. Needs fixed_stocks>=2. Set enabled:false for plain Supertrend-line exits only.
_contract_selection_comment: contract_selection: 'active' (default) picks IBKR's ContFuture active/liquid front month; 'quarterly' restricts to Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec (H/M/U/Z) so the instrument rolls on the SAME quarterly cycle as MNQ/MES (used for MGC to keep its expiry month in sync with the index futures); 'nearest' = legacy nearest calendar expiry. roll_buffer_days (0=off) skips any expiry within N days of expiring so it rolls BEFORE the contract thins into expiry. NEEDS REBUILD (code change).
_expiry_pin_comment: expiry (optional, HIGHEST priority) hard-pins one contract month: 'YYYYMM' (e.g. '202612'=Dec 2026) or 'YYYYMMDD'. Overrides contract_selection. Leave unset to auto-select/roll. NOTE on 'quarterly' for MGC: gold reliably lists only Jun/Dec among the quarterly months, so MGC matches MNQ/MES EXACTLY on Jun & Dec; in the Mar/Sep index quarters gold has no liquid Mar/Sep contract, so it uses the nearest listed quarterly (e.g. Jun) — always a liquid gold contract, but may lead the index month by one quarter then.
